purpose: Dallas visual-continuity and event-truth QA gate: validate that personalized realistic-3D chibi assets remain visually stable and semantically correct across full Gamecast play lifecycles before Dallas can close.

visualContinuityContract.cameraRule: Use the canonical Dallas camera family for base, action and celebration frames; never mirror a personalized render when that would mirror the uniform number or identity details.
visualContinuityContract.lightingRule: Preserve the canonical Dallas key/fill/rim relationship across an action sequence so a player does not appear to change complexion or material response between frames.
visualContinuityContract.scaleRule: Player scale is stable within a scene except authored perspective changes; scale may not be used to imply identity or position.
visualContinuityContract.footAnchorRule: Ground-contact anchor remains continuous from entry through action, celebration and recovery.
visualContinuityContract.alphaRule: Production frames retain clean transparent alpha without baked stadium/background pixels or edge halos.
visualContinuityContract.footballRule: At most one authoritative football is visible and its owner/location follows play truth rather than animation timing.

eventTruthMatrix.required: QB throw resolves to eligible receiver catch/run-after-catch; football ownership transfers once at catch truth.
No receiver possession celebration; ball becomes non-owned at authoritative incompletion.
Possession transfers to the resolved defender once; offensive personalized celebration is suppressed.
Ball carrier uses roster-authorized run family and retains football until tackle, score, fumble or play end.
Carrier ownership clears at fumble truth and recovery is assigned only after authoritative recovery identity resolves.
QB sack reaction and resolved defender sack action share one play clock; Von Miller may route to DeSoto Shuffle only when he is the authoritative qualifying sacker.
Generic first-down recovery is default; CeeDee Lamb may route to nose-wipe only when he is the authoritative qualifying player and the revision has not consumed it.
Only authoritative scorer receives personalized scoring celebration; teammates may use generic eligible celebration without stealing scorer identity.
Kicker action resolves from authoritative attempt result; made/missed truth is never inferred from animation completion.
Specialist and returner actions remain roster-authorized and football ownership transfers from kick flight to resolved returner only when return truth exists.

qaChecks.assert: Every personalized sequence keeps the same official-headshot-derived visible identity across base, action and celebration frames; no frame may infer or substitute appearance from a name.
Lighting changes cannot materially alter the locked skin-tone appearance between adjacent frames; appearance is evaluated under the canonical lighting family.
Visible jersey numbers agree with roster.json and are never horizontally mirrored to fabricate an opposite-facing pose.
Camera family, player scale and foot anchor remain within authored tolerances through action handoffs and recovery.
Transparent frames have clean silhouette edges with no opaque rectangle, stadium remnant or avoidable fringe halo.
Animation selection, possession and celebration always derive from authoritative Gamecast event truth; animation timing cannot change a play result.
A newer authoritative revision preempts stale choreography before any stale score, turnover, first-down or signature celebration can complete.
CeeDee Lamb nose-wipe and Von Miller DeSoto Shuffle require matching player plus qualifying event plus unconsumed authoritative revision; no name-only routing is allowed.
Players without a verified named signature use eligible generic celebrations only; metadata must not promote a generic motion to an invented named signature.
Missing, invalid or undecodable personalized assets fall back without ever borrowing another player's face, number or signature.
Dallas QA keys and fallback paths remain NFL/DAL scoped and cannot mutate another NFL team or MLB/NHL state.

acceptanceFixtures.assert: Dak Prescott completion to CeeDee Lamb transfers one football exactly once and preserves both player identities through recovery.
An incompletion cannot accidentally trigger catch, first-down or scorer celebration from a prior optimistic frame.
Authoritative interception suppresses stale offensive possession and reconstructs defender ownership without duplicate footballs.
A corrected fumble recovery invalidates the stale recovery player before the corrected personalized action renders.
CeeDee Lamb nose-wipe is eligible only on a qualifying authoritative Lamb first-down revision and only once for that revision.
A Lamb target, catch without first down, teammate first down or repeated poll cannot route to nose-wipe.
Von Miller DeSoto Shuffle is eligible only when Miller is the authoritative qualifying sacker and only once for that revision.
A Miller pressure, assisted non-qualifying event, teammate sack or repeated poll cannot route to DeSoto Shuffle.
Opposite-direction movement uses an authored orientation strategy and never mirrors readable jersey identity incorrectly.
Representative base/action/celebration frames satisfy transparent-background and clean-edge requirements.
A missing personalized asset uses safe Gamecast fallback and never substitutes a different Dallas player.
Executing every Dallas QA/fallback path performs no write to MLB or NHL assets, caches, state or behavior.
